_comment: Cross-language contract for the SSO server-fixed OAuth scopes (ADR-0517 §3.4, #3951).
The scopes are server-fixed — an admin cannot widen them — and enforced only at
which is what start_login() actually sends to the IdP. SsoProviderPanel.tsx
duplicates the same two lists (line ~486) purely for Add-mode display, since no
provider exists yet to read `existing.scopes` from — in Add mode this hardcoded
copy is the ONLY thing the admin sees, so a server-side widening would display a
lie until someone noticed by inspection. This file pins the two copies together:
a pytest reads the server constants, a vitest reads the literal arrays out of
SsoProviderPanel.tsx's source text (it has no exported constant to import).
Changing the fixed scopes: edit OIDC_SCOPES/GITHUB_SCOPES in services.py, the
hardcoded arrays in SsoProviderPanel.tsx, and this file. Any one alone fails.
